title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin held steady through the US close at sixty-four thousand eight hundred eighteen dollars, down just one-tenth of a percent as fear dominated sentiment. The Fear and Greed index at thirty-one signals caution, yet the network shows resilience with hashrate at nine hundred five exahashes per second and over eighty-one thousand transactions in the mempool at a low two sat per vbyte fee.
